tasks.name: 创建博客模型
tasks.description:
创建 Blog 模型用于存储博客信息。需要在 app/models/ 目录下创建 blog.py，包含字段: id, title, content, image_url, created_at。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /blogs (request: {title: str, content: str, image_url: str}) -> {id, title, content, image_url, created_at}
- GET /blogs -> [{id, title, content, image_url, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建博客API
tasks.description:
创建博客的 CRUD API 路由。在 app/routes/ 下创建 blogs.py，包含增删改查接口。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /blogs (request: {title: str, content: str, image_url: str}) -> {id, title, content, image_url, created_at}
- GET /blogs -> [{id, title, content, image_url, created_at}]

tasks.name: 实现图片上传功能
tasks.description:
实现图片上传功能，允许用户上传图片并返回图片的URL。在 app/utils/ 下创建 image_upload.py，处理图片上传逻辑。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /blogs (request: {title: str, content: str, image_url: str}) -> {id, title, content, image_url, created_at}
- GET /blogs -> [{id, title, content, image_url, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建博客前端页面
tasks.description:
创建博客管理的前端页面。在 templates/ 下创建 blogs.html，包含博客创建表单和博客列表展示。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /blogs (request: {title: str, content: str, image_url: str}) -> {id, title, content, image_url, created_at}
- GET /blogs -> [{id, title, content, image_url, created_at}]

T1.implementation_approach: Define a Blog model with fields for title, content, author, and timestamps using a database ORM like Django or SQLAlchemy.
T1.notes: Ensure to include validation for required fields and consider indexing for search optimization.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on the Blog model using a framework like Flask or Django REST Framework.
T2.notes: Implement authentication and authorization to secure the API.

T3.implementation_approach: Integrate a file storage service like AWS S3 or use local storage to handle image uploads, ensuring proper validation and resizing.
T3.notes: Consider using a library like Pillow for image processing and ensure secure upload handling.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a responsive front-end using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks like React or Vue.js to display blog posts and allow user interaction.
T4.notes: Focus on user experience and ensure the design is mobile-friendly.
